ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zone centrally. Low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A single isolated low-intensity circular blob is located on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along most of the trailing edge, interrupted by a significant macro-scale jagged indentation on the distal half of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing boundary, sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters located at the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe and a distinct circular black pigmentation mark on the interior of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The isolated circular black spot on the white background of the left lobe provides a high-contrast unique identifier.
